checks.evidence: Português brasileiro: “A receita preliminar de serviços”.
“A receita preliminar de serviços, sem impostos, foi de R$ 3,8 milhões em abril de 2026”.
“um aumento de 6% em relação a abril de 2025”.
“Os valores ainda não foram auditados.”

ratings.reason: Preserves every substantive detail and clearly identifies the comparison period. No additional source meaning is omitted.

checks.evidence: Português brasileiro: “A receita preliminar de serviços”.
“A receita preliminar de serviços em abril de 2026 foi de R$ 3,8 milhões, sem impostos”.
“6% acima de abril de 2025”.
“Os valores ainda não foram auditados.”

ratings.reason: Preserves the amount, period, tax exclusion, comparison and audit caveat. No additional source meaning is omitted.

cases.preference_reason: Both are clear, faithful Brazilian Portuguese rewrites with no meaningful quality difference.

checks.evidence: Portuguese: “O cliente pode adiar a entrega”.
“O cliente pode adiar a entrega uma única vez”.
“avisando por escrito com pelo menos 4 dias úteis de antecedência”.
“O pagamento já devido continua obrigatório.”

ratings.reason: Retains the optional, one-time postponement, required written notice and continuing payment obligation. No other substantive meaning is omitted.

checks.evidence: Portuguese: “O cliente pode adiar a entrega”.
“O cliente pode adiar a entrega uma única vez”.
“desde que avise por escrito com pelo menos 4 dias úteis de antecedência”.
“O adiamento não cancela o pagamento já devido.”

ratings.reason: Explicitly preserves the notice condition and the payment obligation without changing permission into a requirement. No other substantive meaning is omitted.

cases.preference_reason: Both simplify the wording while preserving all conditions and obligations.

checks.evidence: Spanish: “La tasa de renovación”.
“aumentó del 32% al 38%: una subida de 6 puntos porcentuales, no un incremento relativo del 6%”.
“de las cuentas anuales de junio” and “Estos datos se refieren únicamente a esas cuentas.”

ratings.reason: Preserves the numerical distinction and restricted account scope. The final sentence mildly repeats the scope but omits no substantive meaning.

checks.evidence: Spanish: “La tasa de renovación”.
“subió del 32% al 38%: un aumento de 6 puntos porcentuales, no del 6% relativo”.
“Los datos corresponden únicamente a las cuentas anuales de junio.”

ratings.reason: Clearly preserves every numerical and scope qualification, with no additional source meaning omitted.

cases.preference_reason: B states the scope once in a self-contained sentence, avoiding A's repetition while retaining the same meaning.

checks.evidence: Spanish: “Envía el informe solo cuando”.
“Envía el informe solo cuando Ana y Luis lo aprueben por escrito.”
“No basta la aprobación de uno”.
“ni cuenta el silencio como aprobación”.

ratings.reason: The restricted imperative preserves the prohibition before both written approvals. Single approval and silence remain insufficient; no other substantive meaning is omitted.

checks.evidence: Spanish: “Envía el informe solo si”.
“Envía el informe solo si Ana y Luis lo han aprobado por escrito.”
“Una sola aprobación no basta”.
“el silencio no equivale a aprobación”.

ratings.reason: Preserves both written approvals as a prerequisite, together with the explicit exclusions of single approval and silence. No other substantive meaning is omitted.

cases.preference_reason: Both clearly preserve the necessary approvals and the two explicit exclusions.

checks.evidence: French: “Le coût est estimé”.
“Le coût est estimé à 2 900 € HT par trimestre”.
“HT” denotes the tax exclusion; “auxquels s’ajoutent 450 € de frais d’installation” keeps installation outside the quarterly amount.
“Cette estimation ne constitue pas un devis ferme.”

ratings.reason: Uses conventional French pricing shorthand and preserves the separate installation charge and nonbinding estimate. No additional substantive meaning is omitted.

checks.evidence: French: “Le coût est estimé”.
“Le coût est estimé à 2 900 euros par trimestre”.
“hors TVA” and “Les frais d'installation de 450 euros ne sont pas inclus.”
“Cette estimation n'est pas un devis ferme.”

ratings.reason: Explicitly preserves the quarterly estimate, both exclusions and the absence of a firm quote. No additional source meaning is omitted.

cases.preference_reason: Both clearly preserve the pricing and estimate qualifications; shorthand versus explicit wording creates no meaningful quality difference.
